findings.detail: The translation omits the comparison «than someone» and leaves «считает» without a clear grammatical subject. findings.detail: The construction «Как лучше разобраться во всём, чем с головой бросить его…» is an awkward calque in Russian: the comparison lacks a natural governing construction. Recast the rhetorical question while preserving the idea that immersing him in the company is an excellent way to learn.
